LBY.note: The decision refers to data protection legislation only in general terms and names no data protection law.
The decision gives the Government Communication Centre ownership of the platform and its data but sets no rule classifying state data or fixing where it is held.

facts.fact: Article 8 of Cabinet Decision 705/2024, in force from its issue, requires the Dawlati platform's e-services to be adapted for all users including persons with disabilities, at no extra fee.

Cabinet Decision 705/2024 creates the Dawlati e-platform under the Government Communication Centre to provide e-services and issue official documents, with fees collected and documents verifiable by QR code.
